shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat rectangular slab
repeated motif in a register-like layout
justification: Both are shallow relief panels using flat, outlined forms with minimal interior modelling, and both include rosette-like radiating flower heads (in A as the dominant repeated motif, in B possibly as small filler); otherwise A shows only a vegetal scroll of stems and blossoms rising along a vertical panel, while B shows a narrative battle scene with armed human figures, bows, a siege engine and a fortified wall. There is no shared relationship or scene structure — one is purely ornamental and vertical, the other figural and horizontally narrative.
